reason: Comprehensive review of Repsol's 2024 consolidated financial statements (20-F equivalent) reveals no Total Addressable Market (TAM) disclosure by the company. The filing focuses on financial performance, asset impairment analyses considering energy transition scenarios, operations in various energy segments (Exploration & Production, Refining, Chemicals, Mobility), and climate change impacts on valuations. While the company discusses market dynamics, energy transition, decarbonization commitments, price paths for hydrocarbons/electricity/CO2, and strategic plans (SP 24-27), no specific TAM figures or market size estimates are disclosed by Repsol itself. The document contains extensive discussion of business segments, reserves, production profiles, and strategic objectives, but lacks any company-stated TAM metrics.
